Object.Name: Big Lebowski Theme
Object.Description1: A fictional LwM2M Object representing the thematic core of the film "The Big Lebowski": abiding through chaos, mistaken identity, friendship, absurdity, and detachment.

Item.Name: AbidesLevel
Item.Description: Measures how strongly the object embodies calm persistence in the face of disorder. 0 means not abiding at all; 10 means complete serenity amid chaos.

Item.Name: ChaosIndex
Item.Description: Represents the surrounding level of absurdity, confusion, and narrative instability.

Item.Name: MistakenIdentity
Item.Description: Indicates whether mistaken identity is a defining driver of the scenario.

Item.Name: FriendshipStrength
Item.Description: Captures the emotional and narrative importance of companionship and group ritual.

Item.Name: RugSignificance
Item.Description: Symbolic description of comfort, dignity, and the desire for order.

Item.Name: BowlingRitualEnabled
Item.Description: Indicates whether recurring communal ritual is part of the object's thematic model.

Item.Name: DreamSequenceIntensity
Item.Description: Represents how strongly fantasy, subconscious imagery, and surreal detours shape meaning.

Item.Name: ThemeSummary
Item.Description: Human-readable summary of the theme: life is chaotic and often senseless, but identity, friendship, and relaxed endurance provide a way through it.

Item.Name: DonnySTFU
Item.Description: Indicates whether Donny is being told to be quiet. true means the thematic state includes the recurring "shut the f*** up, Donny" dynamic.

Item.Name: WalterResource
Item.Description: Represents the volatile, absolutist, and aggressively principled energy embodied by Walter. May be used to describe rule enforcement, combativeness, or escalation of trivial situations.
